answer: Cap influence on a mesa plateau: no identity gains more weight after 500 POA staked for 40 epochs, so splitting stake across fakes yields no extra power. A newcomer must also grow through a trellis of three unrelated sponsors, each risking 100 POA for 15 epochs, and pass four audits by different reviewers. If one audit fails, sponsors lose 25% and the identity resets to a lotus probationary tier with zero weight for 12 epochs. Each extra fake needs three fresh sponsors, a new 40-epoch wait, and another audit gauntlet, while honest identities gain trust, not extra power.
